atoms.description: Explicit many-to-one feature joins preserving all query rows and order.

inputs.name: queries
inputs.constraints: Query DataFrame with unique columns and nonmissing declared join keys. Preserve original row order, duplicates and index.

inputs.name: feature_tables
inputs.constraints: Ordered (DataFrame, key-list) pairs. Keys must be unique/nonmissing on feature side; non-key collisions are rejected.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Owned query-preserving DataFrame with missing joins retained for a separate explicit imputation policy.

atoms.description: Latest available original row indices and missing mask on one int64 clock.

inputs.name: observed_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

outputs.name: indices
outputs.constraints: Original row indices aligned to queries; -1 denotes unavailable. Equal-time ties select last input row.

outputs.name: available
outputs.constraints: Query-aligned availability mask; false indices must not be dereferenced.

atoms.description: Calendar features with an explicit holiday schedule and coverage checks.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: Nonmissing timezone-naive query timestamps on the declared reference/calendar clock.

inputs.name: holiday_midnights
inputs.constraints: Sorted unique nonmissing timezone-naive holiday midnights covering the query horizon; caller chooses calendar rules.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Eight query-aligned calendar arrays; holiday membership uses date, countdown uses the next midnight and whole elapsed days.

atoms.description: Add an aligned offset, clip, then truncate predictions toward zero.

inputs.name: values
inputs.constraints: Finite real prediction vector aligned exactly with offset, in the same output units; no broadcasting or input mutation.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.constraints: Aligned finite additive offset vector in prediction units.

inputs.name: lower
inputs.constraints: Ordered exact integer clipping bounds within the supported float64 integer range, in prediction units.

inputs.name: upper
inputs.constraints: Ordered exact integer clipping bounds within the supported float64 integer range, in prediction units.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Owned int64 vector after offset addition, clipping and truncation toward zero; no rounding-to-nearest.

atoms.description: Available categorical states and full-window change counts on an explicit grid.

inputs.name: observed_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

inputs.name: states
inputs.constraints: Observation-by-channel string matrix with no missing strings; comma and literal substring semantics are explicit.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

inputs.name: vocabulary
inputs.constraints: Unique ordered nonempty literal tokens supplied by the caller; never learned from query rows.

inputs.name: suffixes
inputs.constraints: Unique ordered nonempty suffixes defining match priority; no domain suffixes are inferred.

inputs.name: change_windows
inputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 grid-row counts; a full available window is required before its mask is true.

inputs.name: grid_step
inputs.constraints: Positive integer spacing in the shared clock; query grid must be strictly increasing and regular.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Category/count/change arrays with state_valid and window_valid masks; unavailable placeholders are not observations.

atoms.description: Unique authoritative entity attributes with explicit vocabulary fallbacks.

inputs.name: query_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string query identifiers; order and duplicates are preserved.

inputs.name: record_ids
inputs.constraints: Unique nonempty string identifiers aligned to authoritative snapshot rows; caller establishes snapshot availability.

inputs.name: attributes
inputs.constraints: DataFrame aligned positionally to unique record_ids; columns must be unique; caller establishes authoritative snapshot availability.

inputs.name: vocabularies
inputs.constraints: Explicit unique string vocabularies. Entity keys identify attribute columns; identifier keys are primary, numeric and category.

inputs.name: fallback
inputs.constraints: Explicit nonempty string category fallback; no inference-row category fitting occurs.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Positional query-aligned DataFrame with explicit category fallbacks; unknown passthrough values remain missing.

atoms.description: Latest observed nonmissing estimate fallback with explicit bounds and units.

inputs.name: entity_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string identifiers aligned to estimate history rows; repeated identities are allowed.

inputs.name: observed_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

inputs.name: estimates
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 estimated event times, aligned to history identifiers; estimate_valid governs missing placeholders.

inputs.name: estimate_valid
inputs.constraints: Boolean vector aligned to estimate history; false values mask placeholder estimates.

inputs.name: query_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string query identifiers; order and duplicates are preserved.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

inputs.name: ticks_per_unit
inputs.constraints: Finite positive clock ticks per fallback output unit.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.constraints: Finite scalar subtracted after conversion to fallback output units.

inputs.name: lower
inputs.constraints: Finite ordered clipping bound in fallback output units; missing must lie within bounds.

inputs.name: upper
inputs.constraints: Finite ordered clipping bound in fallback output units; missing must lie within bounds.

inputs.name: missing
inputs.constraints: Finite fallback output value within [lower, upper], in the declared prediction units.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Owned float64 query vector; fractional estimates retained, missing groups use declared fallback.

atoms.description: Per-entity estimate changes, remaining times and query-independent windows.

inputs.name: entity_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string identifiers aligned to estimate history rows; repeated identities are allowed.

inputs.name: observed_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

inputs.name: estimates
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 estimated event times, aligned to history identifiers; estimate_valid governs missing placeholders.

inputs.name: estimate_valid
inputs.constraints: Boolean vector aligned to estimate history; false values mask placeholder estimates.

inputs.name: query_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string query identifiers; order and duplicates are preserved.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

inputs.name: lookbacks
inputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 widths on the shared clock. Membership is (query-width, query].

inputs.name: rounding_step
inputs.constraints: Positive integer observation ceiling-grid spacing on the shared clock; overflow is rejected.

inputs.name: ticks_per_output_unit
inputs.constraints: Positive integer clock ticks per output time unit; applies consistently to time differences.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Query-aligned remaining/change features and query-by-window sum/max/sample-std arrays in declared output units; unavailable features are NaN.

atoms.description: Per-channel event counts requiring both observation and actual availability.

inputs.name: observed_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

inputs.name: actual_at
inputs.constraints: Int64 actual-event times on the observation clock; events cannot count before both actual and observed time. Shape is event rows by channels; masked placeholders are ignored.

inputs.name: countable
inputs.constraints: Boolean event-by-channel mask aligned to actual_at; false entries exclude missing identities, categories or actual times.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

inputs.name: lookbacks
inputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 widths on the shared clock. Membership is (query-width, query].

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Int64 array shaped queries by channels by lookback windows; tied events are counted independently.

atoms.description: Fixed-window event counts and available first-estimate delay statistics.

inputs.name: event_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string identifiers aligned to event rows; events are counted independently without implicit deduplication.

inputs.name: observed_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 observation times on the shared caller-declared clock, aligned to history rows.

inputs.name: actual_at
inputs.constraints: Int64 actual-event times on the observation clock; events cannot count before both actual and observed time.

inputs.name: estimate_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string identifiers aligned to estimate history rows.

inputs.name: estimate_observed_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 estimate observation times on the event/query clock.

inputs.name: estimate_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 estimated event times aligned to estimate identifiers and availability.

inputs.name: estimate_valid
inputs.constraints: Boolean vector aligned to estimate history; false values mask placeholder estimates.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

inputs.name: lookbacks
inputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 widths on the shared clock. Membership is (query-width, query].

inputs.name: rounding_step
inputs.constraints: Positive integer observation ceiling-grid spacing on the shared clock; overflow is rejected.

inputs.name: ticks_per_output_unit
inputs.constraints: Positive integer clock ticks per output time unit; applies consistently to time differences.

outputs.name: mean
outputs.constraints: Query-by-window mean delay in declared output units; NaN for no available values.

outputs.name: maximum
outputs.constraints: Query-by-window maximum delay in declared output units; NaN for no available values.

atoms.description: Issued-as-of forecast history, lead bands, paired contrasts and revisions.

inputs.name: issued_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 forecast issue times; only issues at or before each query are available.

inputs.name: valid_at
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 forecast valid times aligned to issue/value rows; issue-valid pairs must be unique.

inputs.name: values
inputs.constraints: Aligned forecast-row by field float64 matrix; NaN means missing and infinity is rejected. Fields use explicit linear scalar units; circular statistics are not inferred.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: One-dimensional int64 query times on the shared clock; no future observations may contribute. Configuration queries form a regular increasing grid.

inputs.name: history_window
inputs.constraints: Positive integer clock width; historical issue membership is (query-width, query].

inputs.name: lead_bands
inputs.constraints: Nonempty list of (lower, upper] integer lead bounds; lower=None means unbounded below.

inputs.name: contrast_leads
inputs.constraints: Int64 matrix with two lead values per row; subtract right forecast from left within the latest issue only.

inputs.name: revision_lags
inputs.constraints: Nonempty positive int64 issue-row lags for the same valid time; missing revisions remain unavailable.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Query-aligned historical, band, contrast and revision arrays in input channel units; missing values stay NaN and issue_available is explicit.

atoms.description: Declared structured-identifier categories and signed reference-time features.

inputs.name: query_ids
inputs.constraints: Nonempty string query identifiers; order and duplicates are preserved.

inputs.name: query_times
inputs.constraints: Nonmissing timezone-naive query timestamps on the declared reference/calendar clock.

inputs.name: record_ids
inputs.constraints: Unique nonempty string identifiers aligned to authoritative snapshot rows; caller establishes snapshot availability.

inputs.name: delimiter
inputs.constraints: Explicit nonempty identifier field delimiter.

inputs.name: minimum_parts
inputs.constraints: Integer minimum identifier field count of at least two; all parsed fields must be nonempty.

inputs.name: primary_part
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative primary-token field index below minimum_parts.

inputs.name: category_part
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative category field index below minimum_parts.

inputs.name: reference_parts
inputs.constraints: Nonempty ordered list of field indices below minimum_parts, concatenated to parse the reference time.

inputs.name: reference_format
inputs.constraints: Explicit pandas strptime format producing nonmissing timezone-naive reference times.

inputs.name: vocabularies
inputs.constraints: Explicit unique string vocabularies. Entity keys identify attribute columns; identifier keys are primary, numeric and category.

inputs.name: fallback
inputs.constraints: Explicit nonempty string category fallback; no inference-row category fitting occurs.

inputs.name: seconds_per_unit
inputs.constraints: Finite positive seconds per output elapsed-time unit; query and reference clocks must agree.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Positional query-aligned lexical and time features; time features require a known authoritative identity; fallback derivation order is preserved.

atoms.description: Fixed ordered numeric/categorical model inputs without batch-derived fills.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.constraints: Feature DataFrame with unique columns; metadata is excluded by explicit feature_columns.

inputs.name: feature_columns
inputs.constraints: Nonempty unique ordered feature names present in frame and completely covered by disjoint fill policies.

inputs.name: numeric_fills
inputs.constraints: Finite fixed per-column fill values in matching feature units; never fitted to query rows.

inputs.name: categorical_fills
inputs.constraints: String fills for categorical columns; finite integral categories normalize to strings.

inputs.name: integer_dtype
inputs.constraints: Explicit signed NumPy integer dtype. Truncation and overflow are checked, not wrapped.

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Owned DataFrame in exact declared column order and original query index; numeric output has requested signed dtype, categories are strings.

scope: Domain-neutral materialized feature operations with explicit availability, units and runtime policies. Source intake remains unchanged.
limitations: Draft planning is not publication or approval.
